Bash(echo "=== ANSI 256-Color Palette Demo ==="
echo ""
echo "--- Standard 16 colors \(0-15\) ---"
for i in $\(seq 0 15\); do
  printf "\\033[48;5;${i}m %3d \\033[0m" "$i"
  [ $\(\(\($i + 1\) % 8\)\) -eq 0 ] && echo ""
done
echo ""
echo ""
echo "--- 216 color cube \(16-231, sample\) ---"
for i in $\(seq 16 231\); do
  printf "\\033[48;5;${i}m  \\033[0m"
  [ $\(\(\($i - 15\) % 36\)\) -eq 0 ] && echo ""
done
echo ""
echo ""
echo "--- Grayscale ramp \(232-255\) ---"
for i in $\(seq 232 255\); do
  printf "\\033[48;5;${i}m %3d \\033[0m" "$i"
done
echo ""
echo ""
echo "--- Foreground text on dark bg ---"
for i in 46 82 118 154 190 226 220 214 208 202 196; do
  printf "\\033[38;5;${i}m Color ${i} \\033[0m"
done
echo "")
